external_collaboration.evidence_quote: At West Coast Self-Storage we pride ourselves on offering a premier tenant experience. We know that storing can be a stressful experience, so to give you extra peace of mind we’ve partnered with StorageDefender™ at select locations to offer units equipped with StorageDefender monitoring (“Smart Units”)

Alliance Storage is a proud U-Haul Neighborhood Dealer, offering onsite truck rentals to make your move-in seamless. Our knowledgeable team is here to help you choose the right rental equipment for your needs, whether you're moving locally or traveling longer distances.

We’re proud members of the Self Storage Association, as well as the state storage associations in Washington, Oregon, California, Nevada, and Idaho. It’s part of how we stay connected to the industry, advocate for customers, and hold ourselves to a higher standard.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: West Coast Self-Storage is a self-storage property management, acquisition, and development company headquartered in Everett, Washington. The company currently has 164 managed and owned locations with 91 stores in Washington, 31 stores in Oregon, 33 stores in California, 5 stores in Nevada and 4 stores in Idaho comprised of approximately 88,845 units and over 11.5 million square feet of rentable storage space.
